name: Leela Palaces Hotels & Resorts Ltd
title: Leela Palaces Hotels & Resorts Ltd - 544408 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Luxury hotel operator: FY26 PAT Rs403cr with 49% EBITDA margin, but Q4 RevPAR up only 6% on March war disruption to international occupancy; 966 new keys in pipeline add supply, not yet tested by demand.

utilisation.quote: we did an occupancy growth at quarter four, FY26 we were 72%, last year we did 78%

capex.quote: The capex numbers for these hotels remains the same, there is no escalation in the cost, Karan

triggers.label: Q4 occupancy 78% → 72%
triggers.quote: we did an occupancy growth at quarter four, FY26 we were 72%, last year we did 78%

triggers.label: Q4 ADR up ~15% (Rs27k→32k)
triggers.quote: ADR grew by almost 15% from a INR 27,000 we went to INR 32,000

triggers.label: Management says new luxury supply constrained
triggers.quote: new luxury supply in The Leela's key micro-markets remains constrained

triggers.label: OTAs moved to gross billing, costs up
triggers.quote: Expedia and Agoda started charging on a gross basis rather than net basis

guidance.quote: The city hotel will do in mid -70s and resorts will be doing in mid-60s to late 60s.
resorts will be doing in mid-60s to late 60s

guidance.value: Rs65-70 crore at ~40s occupancy, 50-55% EBITDA margin
guidance.quote: We'll do somewhere around INR 65 crores to INR 70 crores will be the first year of revenue
our net debt to EBITDA will remain in the similar levels of 1.6x

guidance.value: high single digit or early double-digit
guidance.quote: we definitely expect maybe a high single digit or early double-digit growth in the month of April
depreciation will almost INR100 crores will remain in the same line in the next two , three years
